import fitz,re
d=fitz.open('realplan.pdf')
p=d[32]
ws=p.get_text('words')
letters=[w for w in ws if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z]',w[4])]
nums=[w for w in ws if re.fullmatch(r'\d{2,4}',w[4])]
pairs=[]
for L in letters:
    lcx=(L[0]+L[2])/2
    for N in nums:
        ncx=(N[0]+N[2])/2
        gap=N[1]-L[3]
        if abs(lcx-ncx)<8 and -2<gap<14:
            pairs.append((L[4],N[4],round(lcx),round(L[1]),round(L[3]-L[1],1),round(N[3]-N[1],1)))
for x in sorted(pairs,key=lambda t:(t[0],t[2])): print(x)
print('total',len(pairs))
" 2>/dev/null
